stories.title: How busy are Flintshire’s roads?
stories.summary: How many vehicles use each main road in Flintshire on an average day, from the A494 at Queensferry to the A55 and the coast road. Department for Transport traffic counts going back to 2000.

stories.title: RSPCA asks for homes in time for Christmas for dogs including shy husky at Colwyn Bay centre
stories.summary: RSPCA Cymru says Husky Daisy is the longest stay dog at its Bryn Y Maen centre, as it appeals for adopters and fosterers across Wales.

stories.title: BBC Director General quizzed on licence fees and cuts to Welsh language services
stories.summary: Further cuts to BBC services in Wales are unavoidable, the broadcaster’s Director General has warned Senedd members, as he called for the £180-a-year TV licence fee, which funds the corporation, to be modernised. stories.title: Fraudsters posing as Barclays and the FCA take £33,000 from North Wales victim, police warn
stories.summary: The scam uses two phone calls, one from a fake Barclays fraud team and one from someone claiming to be from the Financial Conduct Authority.

stories.title: Ken Skates calls for devolution talks to continue after Prime Minister says no to new powers for Wales
stories.summary: Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates has called on the Welsh and UK governments to keep talking about handing more powers to Wales, after the Prime Minister turned down calls to devolve policing, justice, rail infrastructure and The Crown Estate.
